conversation.text:
Police: Alright, I understand. Please describe again the process of how you saw Xiyuan and then took her away.
Respondent: After graduating from the normal university, I worked as an English teacher at a middle school.
Respondent: After divorcing my wife, for various reasons... I resigned from my job at the school. Sometimes I worked as an instructor at training centers, and sometimes I did some private tutoring.
Respondent: It’s just... these jobs didn’t provide stable income... so I was short on money... I’m sorry:
Respondent: I went to that amusement park intending to take away a child who was alone.
Respondent: I observed nearby for more than half an hour. I saw a little girl playing there alone, so I deceived her and took her away...
Respondent: But after bringing her back, I suddenly became afraid and didn’t know how to ask her parents for ransom.
Respondent: So...
Respondent: I sent her back. That’s what happened.
